criteria.no: It requires different subjects or actions that can succeed or fail independently.
criteria.unclear: The clauses cannot be reliably classified as one policy or separate obligations.
criteria.yes: One policy determines the outcome, even if it names several places where the same outcome must hold.

atomic-r2-a-one-policy.instructions: Does anchor.statement state one policy that has one compliance outcome? Conditions and a list of channels, files, or evidence surfaces governed by that same policy remain one constraint. Different subjects or different required actions are separate constraints.

criteria.no: At least two independently enforceable duties are joined in the statement.
criteria.unclear: The statement leaves independence of its duties ambiguous.
criteria.yes: All details enforce the same invariant and would be evaluated together.

atomic-r2-b-same-invariant.instructions: Is anchor.statement one invariant applied to a subject, trigger, and possibly several output surfaces? Do not count the number of nouns or listed artifacts; count independently enforceable duties.

criteria.no: Yes, a split produces independently satisfiable or violable obligations.
criteria.unclear: It is unclear whether the apparent parts can be enforced independently.
criteria.yes: No meaningful split produces independently different outcomes.

atomic-r2-c-separate-enforcement.instructions: Would splitting anchor.statement create two anchors that could receive different compliance results? A single security or redaction rule covering stdout, stderr, and artifacts should not be split merely because it lists surfaces.

anchor.quote: all commands should print machine-readable JSON
anchor.statement: Every CLI command must emit JSON to stdout.
